title: Certificates of Deposit: Partial Withdrawals Before Maturity
content:
Some tiers of Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit let the owner take out part of the principal before maturity while the rest keeps earning. This page lists which tiers allow it and the limits that bind each partial withdrawal.

## Rule

A partial withdrawal before maturity is possible only on a tier that permits it, and each one must satisfy all three limits of that tier:

- it is for at least the tier's smallest partial withdrawal;
- the principal left in the certificate afterwards is at least the tier's remaining-balance floor;
- counting the early partial withdrawals already taken in the current term (from the term start date onward), the new one does not take the term's number above the tier's maximum.

A request that breaks any of these limits is declined as it stands. It is never turned into a different request, such as a smaller sum or a full withdrawal.

## Tier limits

| Tier | Partial withdrawal before maturity | Smallest partial withdrawal | Principal that must remain | Most partial withdrawals per term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | Not permitted | not applicable | not applicable | 0 |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | Not permitted | not applicable | not applicable | 0 |
| 12-Month Certificate | Permitted | USD 500.00 | USD 1000.00 | 2 |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | Permitted | USD 500.00 | USD 2500.00 | 2 |
| 36-Month Certificate | Permitted | USD 500.00 | USD 1000.00 | 2 |
| 60-Month Certificate | Permitted | USD 500.00 | USD 1000.00 | 2 |

## Checklist

1. Does the tier permit partial withdrawals before maturity?
2. Is the sum at least the tier's smallest partial withdrawal?
3. Would the principal left behind meet the tier's floor?
4. Is the count of early partial withdrawals in this term still below the tier's maximum?

A "no" to any one of the four means the partial withdrawal is declined.

## Cases (hypothetical balances)

| Tier and principal | Request | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 60-Month Certificate, USD 10000.00, none taken this term | USD 400.00 | Declined: below the smallest partial withdrawal |
| 60-Month Certificate, USD 10000.00, none taken this term | USD 9500.00 | Declined: USD 500.00 would remain, below the floor |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, USD 12000.00, none taken this term | USD 3000.00 | Within all limits |
| 36-Month Certificate, USD 15000.00, two taken this term | USD 1000.00 | Declined: the term's maximum is already reached |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate, USD 8000.00 | USD 1000.00 | Declined: the tier does not permit a partial withdrawal |
